parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a fundamental particle.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: A nucleus X has 14 nucleons and $p$ protons. The ratio of charge to mass for nucleus X is $4.1\times10^7\,\mathrm{C\,kg^{-1}}$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Nucleus X undergoes $\beta^{-}$ decay to form nucleus Z.

Complete the equation representing this decay.

$$^{14}_{\ldots}\mathrm{X}\;\rightarrow\;^{\ldots}_{\ldots}\mathrm{Z}+{}^{\ldots}_{\ldots}\ldots+{}^{\ldots}_{\ldots}\ldots$$

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A sample of a radioactive substance emits particles that are positively charged and have a continuous range of kinetic energies.

State and explain whether the nuclei in the sample are undergoing $\alpha$-decay, $\beta^{+}$ decay or $\beta^{-}$ decay.
